headline: Frequent Rework of Text Handling Features
diagnosis: The commit history indicates a recurring focus on text handling features, with numerous fixes and enhancements related to text wrapping, positioning, and UI interactions. The specific parts of the code that are frequently touched include constants related to text dimensions and behaviors, which suggests instability in how these features are implemented.
plan: Conduct a code review of all recent commits related to text handling to identify common issues and inconsistencies.
Establish a clear specification for text handling features, including expected behaviors for text wrapping, positioning, and resizing.
Refactor the relevant constants and logic in 'constants.ts' to align with the new specifications, ensuring that edge cases are handled.
Implement comprehensive unit tests for text handling functionalities to prevent regressions and ensure stability in future changes.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the editors team to reduce bus factor.
